visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor mall walkway. A man wearing a tan patterned shirt and a woman with vibrant pink hair tied back, wearing a navy blouse under a cream-colored pinafore dress, are walking toward the camera while engaged in an animated conversation. The background features storefronts and a large 'city'super' sign. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the center of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to the couple standing outside a traditional-looking Japanese storefront with wooden shelving and signboards. The man gestures excitedly while the woman looks on with a curious expression. There is a transition effect where they seem to 'teleport' into the store. (3) A rapid montage follows, showcasing various products inside the 'TSUJIRI' shop. The visuals focus on green matcha cakes, gift-wrapped boxes in green fabric, and a video screen showing tea leaves being processed. The lighting is warm and emphasizes the textures of the food and wooden decor. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor classroom or workshop setting within the store. A female instructor in a white shirt and glasses stands before a projector screen displaying text about matcha culture, pointing at diagrams. The couple is seated at a wooden table, watching attentively. (5) Close-up shots show the process of making matcha. The woman uses a bamboo whisk (chasen) to stir green tea powder and water in a dark ceramic bowl. The man then attempts the same, whisking vigorously with a determined facial expression. White text labels identify the ingredients like '梅之白抹茶粉'. (6) The man is shown preparing a more complex beverage. He pours a dark liquid into a glass of white milk and topped with a large swirl of whipped cream, caramel sauce, and a green cookie. He poses with the finished drink, smiling broadly at the camera. (7) The couple sits at a wooden table, taking a selfie together with a smartphone. They both hold their respective matcha drinks and smile. (8) The final scene returns to the mall walkway. The man and woman are talking again; the man eventually walks away to the right, leaving the woman standing alone. She gestures toward a large white sign with black Japanese characters for '辻利茶舖' before the video ends on a clean shot of the logo.

Upbeat, playful BGM with a strong percussive beat plays continuously. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as they move into the shop. (3) The BGM shifts slightly to include synthesized textures reminiscent of Japanese folk music. The dialogue remains fast-paced and cheerful. (4) Frequent 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects are added to emphasize text appearing on screen. The sound of rapid whisking (liquid friction) is clearly audible during the tea-making sequence. (5) A sharp 'click' sound mimicking a camera shutter occurs as they take a photo. (6) The video concludes with the man speaking a humorous closing line in Japanese ('Aishiteru'), followed by the woman's energetic response. The music fades out alongside the dialogue.
